title: Higher torsion cohomology on the affine and punctured lines
statement: Let Ω be algebraically closed, A a commutative ring annihilated by a positive integer n, and F any A-module sheaf on X=A1_Ω. For q≥2, derived evaluation at X and at U=D(t) is zero.

source.place: Steps 1--3, higher-degree vanishing; Milne Section 15; affine-curve cohomological dimension (Stacks 03SC).

proof.text: The affine-space dimension formula over Spec Ω shows that the line has dimension one. Its coordinate basic open is affine and has dimension at most one by the open embedding. Both structure maps are curves. Every section of the abelian sheaf underlying an A-module sheaf is killed by n, and restriction has the same property. Apply the proved general affine-curve version of lem-sc-affine-cohomological-dimension, IsCurve.subsingleton_sheafH_of_two_le_of_isAffine, on both curves. Transfer to module-valued derived evaluation using the module-forgetful comparison, evaluation/Ext comparison and open-site cohomology equivalence.

      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :

      (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Line (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)))))).rightDerived q).obj F) ∧
    IsZero (((sections (Line (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))).smallEtaleTopology A
      (openObject (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)))).rightDerived q).obj F)
